seeds.map_and_command_seed: derived from (seed, scenario, episode_index) so that maps and command programs are reproducible

warmup.note: first 1.0 s after reset is excluded from all tracking metrics

metric_definitions.p95_abs_err_*: 95th percentile of |actual - commanded| over evaluation window
metric_definitions.rise_time_s: time from step onset to first sample reaching 90% of step magnitude and staying above 80% for 0.2 s
metric_definitions.stop_drift_m: planar displacement of base between the instant command reaches 0 and 2.0 s later
metric_definitions.stand_drift_m: max planar displacement of base over the 10 s stand window
metric_definitions.max_roll_deg / max_pitch_deg: max |roll|, |pitch| in degrees over evaluation window
metric_definitions.failure_rate: fraction of episodes ending by termination before horizon (base_contact or bad_orientation)
metric_definitions.action_rate_rms: mean over steps of || a_t - a_{t-1} ||_2 on the 12-dim raw action
metric_definitions.joint_limit_rate: fraction of steps where any joint position is within 5% of its limit

nominal.description: reduced perturbation: fixed friction 1.0, no added base mass, no push, obs noise disabled

perturbed.description: training-level and widened perturbation within the same implemented knobs
not_covered: command delay randomization (0-40 ms) is NOT implemented in the current environment and must not be claimed as verified

trial_budget.note: batched over 4096 parallel envs; 4096 episodes of 10-14 s take ~2-3 min total on one L40 (TASK-013 measurement)

checkpoint_selection.normalization: each term divided by its hard threshold
checkpoint_selection.constraint: selected checkpoint must have dev failure_rate <= 0.10; among those pick minimum composite
checkpoint_selection.fallback: if none satisfies the constraint, pick minimum failure_rate and record it as a failure of the acceptance criteria
checkpoint_selection.rule: final_test evaluated exactly once on the selected checkpoint

training_stop_rules.on_wall_clock_exceeded: stop and keep best dev checkpoint, record actual iteration count
training_stop_rules.retrain_policy: at most 1 retry per seed, only if the run is invalidated by an infrastructure error (NaN, crash, resource loss); poor performance is reported as-is and never retried

acceptance.per_scenario: all listed thresholds hold when aggregated over 300 episodes of that scenario in the nominal group
acceptance.perturbed: same thresholds except rmse thresholds relaxed by 20% and failure_rate allowed up to 0.10
acceptance.overall_pass: every scenario passes in nominal; perturbed pass rate >= 80% of scenarios; global failure rate thresholds hold
acceptance.rule: only the metric table can decide pass/fail; failures are reported, not hidden

reporting.aggregation: mean over 3 training seeds; also report per-seed values so seed variance is visible
